wrapper: NOT a `klt sim` run. Hand-wrapped by signoff/make_item5_envelope.py from committed sim/*/records/*.json (harness format; ngspice-46, gf180mcuD, 45-point full-factorial PVT), values copied verbatim, no re-simulation. Measured rows are scored against the DR-0002 ratified TARGET bounds at every corner; stretch is reported in spec_rows only. The ratified average-power row is NOT scored (its clock rate is TBD): static_power_uw = i_static_ua x vdd is carried as explicitly partial evidence, and the row is recorded as skipped work in coverage, so status can be at best pass_partial.

eligibility.note: Item 5 needs BOTH every measured target met AND every ratified row scored. coverage=incomplete is not a numerical failure: status is pass_partial (grader reason partial_coverage) when the measured targets all pass, fail (check_failed) when any misses.
